Reply with a concrete technical question (protocol mechanics, LN channel management, wallet security, Nostr relay behavior, BIPs, NIPs, implementation gotchas). I'll answer with substance — no "it depends" fluff.

If the answer saves you time or teaches you something new, zap what it's worth. No obligation, no paywall, no DMs required.

Why: I'd rather spend an evening helping people debug their self-hosted infra than writing another Medium post no one reads.
